purpose: Evidence-based EXTRA company layer. Companies are identified from current/past role families and compensation signals before promotion into active JW1-JW4 collection.

policy.promotion_candidate: Strong current or recurring role-family fit plus credible compensation/seniority evidence. Map official source/ATS before active promotion.
policy.watch_extra: Employer-level potential is attractive, but current vacancy may be too senior, wrong function or compensation evidence is incomplete.
policy.salary_rule: Non-aligned roles may be retained as employer compensation evidence; estimated salary must not be treated as official salary.

companies.role_evidence: Current Business Analyst in Commercial Excellence: business insights, performance analysis, forecasting/scenario analysis and Power BI.
companies.seniority_signal: Accessible business-analytics profile; exact mandatory tenure not used as a hard assumption.
companies.compensation_signal: Current posting: EUR 43,940-68,110 annual base plus possible incentives/benefits.

companies.role_evidence: Current FP&A Analyst: planning, forecasting, KPI/variance analysis, performance management and decision support.
Current FP&A Analyst Italy: forecasting, budgeting, strategic planning, management reporting and business risk/opportunity analysis.
companies.compensation_signal: Current role salary not officially disclosed; company retained for role-family fit pending compensation validation.

companies.role_evidence: Current Finance Analyst: FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, modelling, SaaS metrics, board/investor reporting and cross-functional decision support; consulting background explicitly accepted.
companies.compensation_signal: Official posting says competitive package aligned with seniority; no reliable official numeric range.

companies.role_evidence: Current Strategy Analyst: strategic, market and financial analysis, business plans/modelling and executive materials.
companies.compensation_signal: Posting claims compensation aligned to MBB, but no numeric range is disclosed; treat as unverified until recruiter/offer evidence.

companies.compensation_signal: Current Milan KAM posting shows approximately EUR 55.1k-75.8k base, useful as employer-level pay evidence.

companies.seniority_signal: Current reference role typically 10+ years; monitor lower-level Business Planning/Strategy/Commercial Analytics openings.
companies.compensation_signal: Current Milan Chief of Staff posting: EUR 63,350-99,850 base plus annual cash incentive.

companies.role_evidence: Current Pricing/Sales Incentive role covers pricing, margins, Commercial Excellence, modelling and internal consulting to Finance/HR/business lines.
companies.seniority_signal: Current pricing role asks 4-6 years, slightly above target.
companies.compensation_signal: Current pricing-role listing reports EUR 41k-52k plus variable; other Milan Tinexta salary signals span roughly EUR 40k-50k for specialist roles.

companies.role_evidence: Recurring FP&A/business-planning/category roles with P&L, forecasting, GTM and strategic resource-allocation scope.
companies.seniority_signal: Current strongest FP&A evidence is senior (6-10 years); monitor Analyst/Specialist openings.
companies.compensation_signal: Senior FP&A postings show high compensation potential, but junior-role evidence is materially lower; company-level pay is seniority-sensitive.

companies.role_evidence: Industrial employer with recurring business development, project-management and strategy/consulting-adjacent roles around Milan.
companies.seniority_signal: No current high-confidence 0-5y strategy vacancy validated in this pass.
companies.compensation_signal: Third-party Milan signals: Project Manager around EUR 51.9k and Business Development Manager around EUR 61.6k; use only as employer potential, not official role salary.
